payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute prefix and suffix OR arrays, then for each index, consider multiplying that element by x^k and combine with others via precomputed ORs, and take the maximum result.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates over all elements to decide which one to apply operations on, evaluating resulting OR using precomputed prefix/suffix ORs. It is exhaustive search (complete search), not greedy.
